protocol.authorization: User requested testing exponential/geometric reweighting as r increases, without retraining.
protocol.status: new hypothesis after observing v1 tests; new random test draws, same generator families
protocol.training: none; all 30 existing best checkpoints frozen by v1 validation selection
protocol.learned_parameters: unchanged; no optimizer, gradients, threshold fitting, or model selection

coefficient_rules.original: v1 binomial; exp/geometric keep lambda/rho calibrated at train r=4
coefficient_rules.solver: 100 bisection steps in log parameter [-40,40], float64 softmax; r=4 reuses original exactly
coefficient_rules.r4: one common evaluation, shared by original/matched; not counted twice
coefficient_rules.inner_MLP: excluded; plain filters only, as in the mathematical question

data.exact_duplicates: reject labeled adjacencies against all same-size v1 data and new test draws
data.isomorphism: no claim of isomorphic/topological disjointness; stress uses the original construction
data.selection: all generated examples, no filtering by model predictions or class label

evaluation.stress_pair_metric: fraction of templates with both answers correct
evaluation.save: raw logits, labels, graph/query IDs, metadata, state norms, timing, memory, actual coefficients
evaluation.timing: observed forward time on the common workload, no claim of isolated latency benchmarking

comparisons: matched vs original at each r=8,16,32
matched vs binomial at same r

statistics.summary: mean and sample SD over five model seeds, each cell separately
statistics.intervals: exact 3125 resamples of paired model-seed differences; conditional on common test draws
statistics.claims: exploratory; no multiplicity-adjusted significance claim; no best-r selection

limits.stop: no automatic budget increase or training fallback
